fixes.name: Reset Windows Update
fixes.description: Stops the update services, renames the SoftwareDistribution and catroot2 folders so Windows builds fresh ones, then starts the services again. Use it when updates fail or stay stuck. The old folders are kept with a .wintool-<date> suffix and can be deleted later.

fixes.name: Reset network
fixes.description: Clears the DNS cache and resets Winsock and the TCP/IP stack for IPv4 and IPv6. Use it when websites do not load while the connection looks fine. Static IP settings may need to be entered again.

fixes.name: Repair system files
fixes.description: Runs DISM RestoreHealth to repair the Windows component store, then System File Checker to fix protected system files. It can take 15 minutes or more and needs an internet connection for DISM.

steps.label: SFC: scan and repair system files

fixes.name: Repair winget
fixes.description: Installs Microsoft's WinGet PowerShell module and runs its repair command, which reinstalls App Installer and its dependencies. If that fails, WinTool registers App Installer again from the copy Windows already has.
